The CV, abridged (Zaira Christa Barakat, london)

Web designer + brand strategist. Builds sites end to end in Wix and in HTML + JavaScript, then works out what a page is failing to do (a missing call to action, say) and fixes it. King's College London MA, Oxford BA, a good eye for what's right and what's nearly right.

  • +33%ticket sales for Oxford Fashion Gala, running the Instagram campaign (300 → 400)
  • ×2ticket sales as co-creative director, concept to runway (150 → 300)
  • 1k → 6kaccounts engaged in the two weeks after The Reach Riverside launched
  • 2London Fashion Week runway shows. Press: British Vogue, Vanity Fair
